questions.q: Explain how inequality can be both a cause and a consequence of market failure.

ideas.label: Market failures such as monopsony or imperfect information cause inequality
Inequality means the poor can't afford education or health care, so these are under-consumed

questions.model: Monopsony power and imperfect information can hold down wages, which causes inequality. In turn, those on low incomes cannot afford enough education or health care, so these are under-consumed.

tests.answer: Monopsony keeps wages low, which causes inequality, and poor people can't afford education so it is under-consumed.
